research_interest: My research interests lie at the intersection of pathogen genomics, infectious disease epidemiology, and global health security. I am interested in using genomic and computational approaches to investigate pathogen evolution, transmission, and emergence, and to strengthen genomic surveillance, early detection, and pandemic preparedness. I also have a strong interest in biosecurity, and the responsible governance of biological research, including dual-use risks, with a focus on strengthening pathogen detection and response capacity in resource-limited settings.

experience.summary: Lead bioinformatics research, pathogen genomic surveillance activities, and institutional capacity-building programs, with a focus on infectious diseases, antimicrobial resistance, and genomic data analysis.
Assisted faculty in delivering lectures and practical lab sessions on bacteriology and microbial physiology while reviewing student research proposals.
Designed scalable NGS Bash analysis pipelines and analyzed global cholera outbreak data using R.
